audit.whatIsWrong: The chart was almost exactly inverted. Level 1 was given to Cassiopeia while whys[0] calls it 'the one stage you cleanly own'; levels 3, 4-5, first item and 2+ items were all given to Kennen while their own whys say she out-trades, out-sustains, out-DPSes and cannot be duelled.
audit.why: Kennen's only clean window is level 1, before Miasma exists. From 3 onward Noxious Blast on 3.5s and Twin Fang on 0.75s beat single-Q chip, and her items perma-slow him out of range. A 47.27% win rate fits a chart where Kennen owns one row, not five. The packet levelChart matches every whys[N].
audit.corrected: Chart set to Kennen / Skill / Skill / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia in both layers, with phases[0], [2], [3], [5] and [6].why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers, and the page told the reader to 'trade around Miasma's cooldown' without ever saying what it is or that her other two spells effectively have none.
audit.why: Miasma is 24/22/20/18/16 — by far her longest cooldown and the only real window. Noxious Blast is 3.5s flat and Twin Fang 0.75s flat, so 'wait for her cooldown' is meaningless for Q and E. Petrifying Gaze is 120/100/80 against Kennen's flat 120 — level and rank matter for who gets the second ultimate.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt with all four numbers; dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and phases[3].why now carry them.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most actionable interaction in the matchup was never stated anywhere: Petrifying Gaze only STUNS enemies facing her, and merely slows anyone with their back turned. The page also never named Twin Fang's heal, and content wants.foe[0] calls Twin Fang '(W)' when it is her E.
audit.why: Riot's text for Petrifying Gaze: a swirl from her eyes stunning enemies in front of her that are FACING her, and slowing any others with their back turned. Turning and running converts a 120s stun into a slow — that is a decision the reader can act on. Twin Fang deals increased damage to poisoned targets and heals her for a percentage of the damage.
audit.corrected: report[5].t now states the facing rule and the Twin Fang heal; report[8].t buys Oblivion Orb; wants.foe[0] corrected to name Noxious Blast and Twin Fang correctly.

notes: All four packet suspectNames are FALSE POSITIVES — Thundering Shuriken, Lightning Rush and Petrifying Gaze are all correct Riot names. Following the mirror audit's ruling, I did NOT assert anywhere that Miasma's grounding disables Lightning Rush: Riot calls Lightning Rush a morph into lightning form that passes through units, the kit derives no dash flag for it, and grounding stops 'Movement abilities' — whether that includes the morph is not answerable from this data. Where the page leaned on that claim I substituted Miasma's slow, which is verified and gives the same practical advice; the remaining instances in content.mid, content.early, whys[2] and whys[3] were left alone rather than guessed at, and are listed as unverified. Five level-chart rows flipped in matched pairs onto the packet's chart.
